notes.key_messages: • A greater focus on the relationship between total, average and marginal variables would be helpful.
notes.general_comments:
The mean percentage score on this paper was 63.7%. Nineteen of the thirty items had facility and
discrimination scores which were well within the test design limits. As was the case in the corresponding
paper in 2012, the paper contained many items, Questions 1, 2, 7, 15, 16, 18, 19, and 24, which candidates
found to be too easy.
